messages:
Oncall SRE: :rotating_light: us-east1 GPU serving pool experiencing burst OOMs/backpressure since 08:05 UTC. Autoscaler failing to recover, queue length spiking, ~15% of hosted requests getting 503s. Investigating.
Samir Patel: Observed repeated kernel OOMs on gpu-pool-3 nodes, seeing nvlink errors in dmesg. No successful autoscale up yet. Tagging affected customers.
Maya Chen: Support Bot shows 23 distinct customer errors in the last 10m, top impacted: acme.com, atlas.ai, a couple of enterprise sandboxes.
Diego Alvarez: Kicking off a manual nodepool scale, but regional capacity is constrained. Creating a new pool may take 12-20m.
Elaine Wong: Recommend immediate traffic migration to us-east2 for critical customers. Expect p95 bump ~20-40ms and some cold starts. Suggest 10% canary first.
Oncall SRE: Agreed. Starting migration script now. Command: ```python tools/traffic_shift.py --from=us-east1 --to=us-east2 --percent=10 --route=hosted```
Samir Patel: Note: KV cache may miss on failover. Add header to preserve cache where possible: `X-RW-FORCE-KV: true`. Also watching for auth token churn.
Maya Chen: I'll draft the status page blurb. Draft: 'Degraded GPU capacity in us-east1 is causing elevated errors for some customers. Traffic migration to a nearby region is underway. We will post updates every 30 minutes. ETA for full restoration: 2-3 hours.'
Paolo Rossi: Support prepping canned responses and escalations for enterprise seats — will include status link and phone contact. Marking priority customers for manual outreach.
Support Bot: Notifying affected customers with active incidents: acme.com, atlas.ai, beta-corp. Messages queued.
StatusPage Bot: Update prepared: Title: 'Partial outage — us-east1 GPU serving degraded'. Body: 'We are migrating traffic to us-east2 to reduce errors. Some requests may see increased latency. Next update in 30 minutes.' React :thumbsup: to approve publish.
Diego Alvarez: Canary (10%) migration in progress — seeing slight latency increase but 503s falling for canary traffic (from ~15% to ~3%). Recommend ramp to 50% if metrics hold.
Elaine Wong: Proceed to 50%. Samir coordinate telemetry checks (errors, 99th, and auth failures).
Samir Patel: Increasing to 50% now. Monitoring logs, SLO dashboards, and kernel OOM rate.
Maya Chen: Published status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1817654321 — included ETA and mitigation steps.
Oncall SRE: 50% migration complete. Migrated traffic seeing baseline error rates. us-east1 pool still unstable; opened cloud ticket to evict suspected faulty hardware. Cloud estimates 2h for full recovery.
Paolo Rossi: Support notified key contacts and opened escalation calls for 2 enterprise customers. Tracking in CRM.
Diego Alvarez: Beginning controlled drain of affected nodes to force reschedule. Command (abbreviated): ```gcloud compute instances delete <id> --zone=us-east1-b && ./infra/roll_nodes.sh --driver=470xx``` Rolling new nodes with pinned driver.
Samir Patel: Watch for firmware rollouts — if new nodes fail to attach, fallback plan is keep traffic routed to us-east2 + us-central1 until pool is healthy.
Oncall SRE: Next full incident check-in in 20 minutes. If anyone sees urgent customer escalations, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
